     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneFibrePresentedProducerFiniteGlue
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneLocus
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffFaithfullyFlatDescent
     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtAffEtaleSeparated
    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# Descent of the canonical rank-one divisor from an étale witness
    13	
    14	Assuming the rank-one divisor **uniqueness interface** (`RankOneDivisorUniqueness`): over any
    15	affine test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened divisor class has
    16	that Abel value — the missing-item interface to be discharged by a later session.
    17	
    18	Under this hypothesis, a widened divisor over the carrier of an étale cover of the test whose
    19	Abel value is the restricted input class **descends uniquely** to the test algebra
    20	(`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness`): uniqueness at the tensor square of the
    21	carrier manufactures the two-coprojection agreement demanded by the faithfully-flat descent
    22	theorem `DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq`, and the Abel value of the descended class
    23	is pinned by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`.
    24	
    25	The first consumer is the finite glue on a Noetherian presentation carrier
    26	(`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation`), whose Abel conjunct is exactly the
    27	étale witness above.  The unique class is then extracted as the **canonical rank-one divisor**
    28	of a presentation (`canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation`), with its Abel equation and
    29	uniqueness accessors.
    30	
    31	This file does not construct `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, does not prove independence of
    32	the chosen presentation beyond what uniqueness already gives, and does not discharge the
    33	uniqueness interface itself.
    34	-/
    35	
    36	set_option autoImplicit false
    37	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    38	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
    39	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
    40	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    41	
    42	universe u
    43	
    44	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    45	open scoped TensorProduct
    46	
    47	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    48	
    49	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    50	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    51	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    52	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    53	
    54	/-- **The rank-one divisor uniqueness interface**: over every affine test whose plus class
    55	lies in the rank-one locus, at most one widened locally certified divisor class of degree
    56	`genus C` has Abel value the input class.
    57	
    58	This is the sanctioned missing-item interface of the canonical-divisor route: producers prove
    59	existence (the finite glue and its descent below), while injectivity of the widened Abel map
    60	on the rank-one locus is to be discharged by a later session.  Stated as a named `Prop` so
    61	consumers can take it as a single hypothesis. -/
    62	def RankOneDivisorUniqueness : Prop :=
    63	  ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    64	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k S)),
    65	    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k S)) →
    66	    ∀ F G : DivFamZarAff C S (genus C),
    67	      abelDivAffPlus C S F = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 →
    68	      abelDivAffPlus C S G = picEtAffineEquiv C S lam.1 → F = G
    69	
    70	/-- **Descent of an Abel-correct divisor witness along an étale cover**: a widened divisor
    71	class over the carrier of an étale cover of `A` whose Abel value is the restriction of the
    72	input rank-one plus class descends to a unique Abel-correct widened divisor class over `A`.
    73	
    74	The tensor-square cocycle condition of `DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq` is not
    75	assumed: it is manufactured from the uniqueness interface, applied over the tensor square of
    76	the carrier to the two coprojection pullbacks of the witness — both have Abel value the
    77	restriction of the input class along the (single) structure map `A → E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier`,
    78	because the two coprojections agree after the structure map of the cover.  The Abel value of
    79	the descended class is recovered by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`
    80	(`PicEtAff.map_injective_of_etaleCover`). -/
    81	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness
    82	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
    83	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    84	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A))
    85	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
    86	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) (F' : DivFamZarAff C E.Carrier (genus C))
    87	    (habel : abelDivAffPlus C E.Carrier F' =
    88	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
    89	        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) :
    90	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
    91	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
    92	  classical
    93	  set φ0 : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier := (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφ0
    94	  set φL : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
    95	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
    96	      E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφL
    97	  set φR : E.Carrier →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier :=
    98	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
    99	      E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).restrictScalars k with hφR
   100	  set ψ : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier := φL.comp φ0 with hψ
   101	  -- both coprojections restrict to the structure map of the tensor square
   102	  have hψR : φR.comp φ0 = ψ := by
   103	    rw [hψ]
   104	    exact AlgHom.ext fun a =>
   105	      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
   106	        E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).commutes a).trans
   107	        ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
   108	          E.Carrier →ₐ[A] E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier).commutes a).symm
   109	  -- the input class restricted to the tensor square stays in the rank-one locus
   110	  set lam_sq : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ)
   111	      (overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)) :=
   112	    (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.overSpecMap ψ).op lam with hlam_sq_def
   113	  have hlam_sq : lam_sq ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj
   114	      (op (overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier))) :=
   115	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.overSpecMap ψ).op hlam
   116	  have hsq : picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1
   117	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C ψ (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :=
   118	    picEtAffineEquiv_naturality C ψ lam.1
   119	  -- both coprojection pullbacks of the witness have the restricted Abel value
   120	  have habelL : abelDivAffPlus C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)
   121	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φL F')
   122	      = picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1 := by
   123	    rw [hsq, ← abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φL F', habel, ← PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp, ← hψ]
   124	  have habelR : abelDivAffPlus C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier)
   125	        (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φR F')
   126	      = picEtAffineEquiv C (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq.1 := by
   127	    rw [hsq, ← abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φR F', habel, ← PicEtAff.mapAlg_comp, hψR]
   128	  -- uniqueness over the tensor square manufactures the descent cocycle
   129	  have htensor : DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φL F' = DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom φR F' :=
   130	    hu (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) lam_sq hlam_sq _ _ habelL habelR
   131	  obtain ⟨F, hF, -⟩ := DivFamZarAff.exists_descent_of_tensor_eq E F' htensor
   132	  rw [← hφ0] at hF
   133	  -- the Abel value of the descended class, by étale separatedness of `PicEtAff`
   134	  have hmapF : PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (abelDivAffPlus C A F)
   135	      = PicEtAff.mapAlg C φ0 (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) := by
   136	    rw [abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom φ0 F, hF, habel]
   137	  have habelF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
   138	    apply PicEtAff.map_injective_of_etaleCover C E
   139	    rw [PicEtAff.mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C φ0 rfl,
   140	      PicEtAff.mapAlg_eq_map_of_toRingHom_eq_algebraMap C φ0 rfl] at hmapF
   141	    exact hmapF
   142	  exact ⟨F, habelF, fun G hG => hu A lam hlam G F hG habelF⟩
   143	
   144	/-- **The unique Abel-correct divisor of a rank-one local presentation**: over a rank-one
   145	plus class with a tied local presentation on a Noetherian étale carrier, there is a unique
   146	widened divisor class over the test algebra whose Abel value is the input class.
   147	
   148	Existence: the finite glue
   149	`PicRankOneLocalPresentation.exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation`
   150	produces an Abel-correct witness over the presentation carrier, which descends by
   151	`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness`.  Uniqueness is the interface `hu`. -/
   152	theorem existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation
   153	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
   154	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   155	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   156	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   157	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   158	    ∃! F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C),
   159	      abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 := by
   160	  obtain ⟨-, -, -, -, F0, -, -, habel, -, -, -⟩ :=
   161	    P.exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
   162	  exact existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness pi hu lam hlam P.cover F0 habel
   163	
   164	/-- **The canonical rank-one divisor of a presentation**: the unique widened divisor class
   165	over the test algebra whose Abel value is the presented rank-one plus class, chosen from
   166	`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation`.  By uniqueness, the choice does not
   167	depend on the internal data of the glue — only on the class, the membership certificate,
   168	and the presentation carrier's Noetherianity. -/
   169	noncomputable def canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation
   170	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
   171	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   172	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   173	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   174	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   175	    DivFamZarAff C A (genus C) :=
   176	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose
   177	
   178	/-- The canonical rank-one divisor satisfies the Abel equation: its widened Abel value is
   179	the presented rank-one plus class. -/
   180	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_abel
   181	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
   182	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   183	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   184	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   185	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
   186	    abelDivAffPlus C A (canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation pi hu hlam P)
   187	      = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1 :=
   188	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose_spec.1
   189	
   190	/-- Any Abel-correct widened divisor class equals the canonical rank-one divisor. -/
   191	theorem canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation_unique
   192	    (hu : RankOneDivisorUniqueness pi)
   193	    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   194	    {lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)}
   195	    (hlam : lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k A)))
   196	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   197	    (F : DivFamZarAff C A (genus C))
   198	    (hF : abelDivAffPlus C A F = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) :
   199	    F = canonicalRankOneDivisorOfPresentation pi hu hlam P :=
   200	  (existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_localPresentation pi hu hlam P).choose_spec.2 F hF
   201	
   202	end AlgebraicGeometry

import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Comma.Over.Basic

/-!
# The Σ-extension of a presheaf on a slice (DAT-6, stage 2)

A presheaf `F` on the slice `Over S` extends to a presheaf on the ambient category:
`F̃(T) := Σ (a : T ⟶ S), F(Over.mk a)` — an element is a structure morphism together
with an element of `F` at the corresponding slice object.  This is the *slice trick*
of the Wave-4 datum campaign (worksheet §1.2.1): for `S = Spec k'` and `F` the
degree-zero Picard functor, `F̃` is the big-site carrier that mathlib's 01JJ
local-representability engine consumes, and a representation of `F̃` descends to a
representation of `F` on the slice with the represented object's structure morphism
the Σ-component of the universal element.

* `CategoryTheory.Over.mkCongr`: the canonical slice morphism `Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk b`
  of an equality `a = b` — an honest `homMk (𝟙 T)`, no `eqToHom`; the whole transport
  calculus of the file is cast-free.
* `CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtension S F : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max v w)`: the Σ-extension,
  with restriction by composition on the Σ-component and by the canonical slice
  morphism `Over.homMk g` on the fibre component.
* `CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtension_ext` / `sigmaExtension_snd_eq`: the transport
  calculus of Σ-elements along equalities of structure morphisms.
* `CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff`: **the amalgamation seam** — a
  restriction of a Σ-element hits a prescribed Σ-element iff the fibre component of
  the source restricts to the prescribed fibre along the canonical slice morphism.
* `CategoryTheory.Over.map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq`: **the compatibility
  descent** — two Σ-elements whose restrictions along the left legs of a pair of
  slice morphisms agree have fibre components agreeing after slice restriction.
* `CategoryTheory.Functor.RepresentableBy.overSlice`: **the Σ-descent** — a
  representation `α` of `sigmaExtension S F` by `J` induces a representation of `F`
  by `Over.mk (α.homEquiv (𝟙 J)).1`; the slice `homEquiv` is plain application of
  `F.map` to the universal element's fibre component.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe w v u

namespace CategoryTheory

open Opposite

namespace Over

variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {S : C}

/-! ## The cast-free transport calculus -/

/-- The canonical slice morphism between `Over.mk`s of equal structure morphisms: an
honest `homMk (𝟙 T)`, never an `eqToHom`. -/
def mkCongr {T : C} {a b : T ⟶ S} (h : a = b) : Over.mk a ⟶ Over.mk b :=
  Over.homMk (𝟙 T) (show 𝟙 T ≫ b = a by rw [Category.id_comp, h])

@[simp]
lemma mkCongr_left {T : C} {a b : T ⟶ S} (h : a = b) : (mkCongr h).left = 𝟙 T :=
  rfl

lemma mkCongr_rfl {T : C} (a : T ⟶ S) : mkCongr (rfl : a = a) = 𝟙 (Over.mk a) := by
  ext
  rfl

/-- Two consecutive canonical morphisms compose to the canonical morphism of the
transitive equality. -/
lemma mkCongr_comp_mkCongr {T : C} {a b c : T ⟶ S} (h : a = b) (h' : b = c) :
    mkCongr h ≫ mkCongr h' = mkCongr (h.trans h') := by
  ext
  change 𝟙 T ≫ 𝟙 T = 𝟙 T
  rw [Category.id_comp]

/-- Any slice morphism into an `Over.mk` factors as the canonical `mkCongr` of its
`Over.w` equation followed by the canonical `homMk` of its left leg. -/
lemma mkCongr_comp_homMk {Y : C} {c : Y ⟶ S} {X : Over S} (g : X ⟶ Over.mk c) :
    (mkCongr (Over.w g).symm : X ⟶ Over.mk (g.left ≫ c)) ≫
        (Over.homMk g.left rfl : Over.mk (g.left ≫ c) ⟶ Over.mk c) = g := by
  ext
  change 𝟙 X.left ≫ g.left = g.left
  rw [Category.id_comp]

section Transport

variable (F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w)

/-- Elements of a Σ-extension fibre agree once they agree after transport along an
equality of the structure morphisms. -/
lemma sigmaExtension_ext {T : C} {a b : T ⟶ S} (hab : a = b)
    {x : F.obj (op (Over.mk a))} {y : F.obj (op (Over.mk b))}
    (hxy : F.map (mkCongr hab).op y = x) :
    (⟨a, x⟩ : Σ c : T ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk c))) = ⟨b, y⟩ := by
  subst hab
  rw [mkCongr_rfl, op_id, F.map_id] at hxy
  exact congrArg (Sigma.mk a) hxy.symm

/-- The second components of equal Σ-elements agree after transport along the equality
of the structure morphisms. -/
lemma sigmaExtension_snd_eq {T : C} {a b : T ⟶ S} (hab : a = b)
    {x : F.obj (op (Over.mk a))} {y : F.obj (op (Over.mk b))}
    (h : (⟨a, x⟩ : Σ c : T ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk c))) = ⟨b, y⟩) :
    F.map (mkCongr hab).op y = x := by
  subst hab
  rw [mkCongr_rfl, op_id, F.map_id]
  exact (eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2).symm

end Transport

variable (S) (F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w)

/-! ## The Σ-extension -/

/-- The restriction map of the Σ-extension along `g : T' ⟶ T`: composition on the
structure morphism, the canonical slice morphism `Over.homMk g` on the fibre
component. -/
def sigmaExtensionMap {T' T : C} (g : T' ⟶ T) :
    (Σ a : T ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk a))) → Σ a : T' ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk a)) :=
  fun x =>
    ⟨g ≫ x.1, F.map (Over.homMk g rfl : Over.mk (g ≫ x.1) ⟶ Over.mk x.1).op x.2⟩

/-- **The Σ-extension** of a presheaf on the slice `Over S` to the ambient category:
`T ↦ Σ (a : T ⟶ S), F(Over.mk a)`. -/
def sigmaExtension : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max v w) where
  obj T := Σ a : T.unop ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk a))
  map g := TypeCat.ofHom (sigmaExtensionMap S F g.unop)
  map_id T := by
    refine ConcreteCategory.hom_ext _ _ fun x => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, ξ⟩ := x
    exact sigmaExtension_ext F (Category.id_comp a) rfl
  map_comp {T₁ T₂ T₃} g h := by
    refine ConcreteCategory.hom_ext _ _ fun x => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, ξ⟩ := x
    change (⟨(h.unop ≫ g.unop) ≫ a,
        F.map (Over.homMk (h.unop ≫ g.unop) rfl :
          Over.mk ((h.unop ≫ g.unop) ≫ a) ⟶ Over.mk a).op ξ⟩
        : Σ c : T₃.unop ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk c)))
      = ⟨h.unop ≫ g.unop ≫ a,
          F.map (Over.homMk h.unop rfl :
            Over.mk (h.unop ≫ g.unop ≫ a) ⟶ Over.mk (g.unop ≫ a)).op
            (F.map (Over.homMk g.unop rfl :
              Over.mk (g.unop ≫ a) ⟶ Over.mk a).op ξ)⟩
    refine sigmaExtension_ext F (Category.assoc h.unop g.unop a) ?_
    rw [← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, ← Functor.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp]
    refine congrArg (fun φ : Over.mk ((h.unop ≫ g.unop) ≫ a) ⟶ Over.mk a =>
      F.map φ.op ξ) ?_
    ext
    change (𝟙 T₃.unop ≫ h.unop) ≫ g.unop = h.unop ≫ g.unop
    rw [Category.id_comp]

variable {S F}

@[simp]
lemma sigmaExtension_obj (T : Cᵒᵖ) :
    (sigmaExtension S F).obj T = Σ a : T.unop ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk a)) :=
  rfl

/-- The computation rule of the Σ-extension's restriction. -/
lemma sigmaExtension_map_mk {T' T : C} (g : T' ⟶ T) (a : T ⟶ S)
    (ξ : F.obj (op (Over.mk a))) :
    (sigmaExtension S F).map g.op ⟨a, ξ⟩
      = ⟨g ≫ a, F.map (Over.homMk g rfl : Over.mk (g ≫ a) ⟶ Over.mk a).op ξ⟩ :=
  rfl

@[simp]
lemma sigmaExtension_map_fst {T' T : C} (g : T' ⟶ T)
    (x : (sigmaExtension S F).obj (op T)) :
    ((sigmaExtension S F).map g.op x).1 = g ≫ x.1 :=
  rfl

/-- **The amalgamation seam**: a restriction of a Σ-element hits a prescribed
Σ-element iff the fibre component of the source restricts to the prescribed fibre
component along the canonical slice morphism over the prescribed structure
morphism. -/
lemma sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff {T' T : C} (g : T' ⟶ T) {a : T ⟶ S} {b : T' ⟶ S}
    (w : g ≫ a = b) (s : F.obj (op (Over.mk a))) (y : F.obj (op (Over.mk b))) :
    (sigmaExtension S F).map g.op ⟨a, s⟩ = ⟨b, y⟩
      ↔ F.map (Over.homMk g (show g ≫ (Over.mk a).hom = (Over.mk b).hom from w) :
          Over.mk b ⟶ Over.mk a).op s = y := by
  subst w
  rw [sigmaExtension_map_mk]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h2 := sigmaExtension_snd_eq F rfl h
    rw [mkCongr_rfl, op_id, F.map_id] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  · intro h
    refine sigmaExtension_ext F rfl ?_
    rw [mkCongr_rfl, op_id, F.map_id]
    exact h.symm

/-- The Σ-extension's restriction along the left leg of a slice morphism `g : Z ⟶

the fibre component is the honest slice restriction `F.map g.op`. -/
lemma sigmaExtension_map_left_mk {Z : Over S} {T : C} {a : T ⟶ S}
    (g : Z ⟶ Over.mk a) (x : F.obj (op (Over.mk a))) :
    (sigmaExtension S F).map g.left.op ⟨a, x⟩
      = ⟨Z.hom, F.map g.op x⟩ :=
  (sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff g.left (Over.w g) x (F.map g.op x)).mpr
    (congrArg (fun φ : Z ⟶ Over.mk a => F.map φ.op x)
      (Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl :
        (Over.homMk g.left (Over.w g) : Z ⟶ Over.mk a) = g))

/-- **The compatibility descent**: two Σ-elements whose Σ-extension restrictions along
the left legs of a pair of slice morphisms with common domain agree have fibre
components agreeing after restriction along the slice morphisms themselves. -/
lemma map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq {Z : Over S} {T T' : C} {a : T ⟶ S}
    {b : T' ⟶ S} {x : F.obj (op (Over.mk a))} {y : F.obj (op (Over.mk b))}
    (gi : Z ⟶ Over.mk a) (gj : Z ⟶ Over.mk b)
    (h : (sigmaExtension S F).map gi.left.op ⟨a, x⟩
        = (sigmaExtension S F).map gj.left.op ⟨b, y⟩) :
    F.map gi.op x = F.map gj.op y := by
  have h' : (⟨Z.hom, F.map gi.op x⟩ : Σ c : Z.left ⟶ S, F.obj (op (Over.mk c)))
      = ⟨Z.hom, F.map gj.op y⟩ :=
    (sigmaExtension_map_left_mk gi x).symm.trans
      (h.trans (sigmaExtension_map_left_mk gj y))
  exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h').2

end Over

open Over

variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {S : C} {F : (Over S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type w}

/-- **The Σ-descent of a representation** (the slice trick, output half): a

import Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Subfunctor.Image

/-!
# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map

`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.

The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not assert that
`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme.  The relative-openness acceptance gate and
the conditional universal-divisor carrier contract are exposed separately in `DivRankOneOpen.lean`.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable section

/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.

Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
def PicRankOneOpen :
    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    rw [e]
    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)

/-! ## The public membership contract -/

/-- The exact producer predicate for the rank-one locus.

This is intentionally lambda-tied and quantifies over every affine pullback.  In particular, it
is stronger than a field-fibre `h⁰ = 1`/`H¹ = 0` statement: a producer must supply the complete
`PicRankOneLocalPresentation` structure for the pulled-back class. -/
def PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) : Prop :=
  ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))

/-- Unfolded membership in `PicRankOneOpen`, with the presentation tied to the pulled-back
Picard class.  Keeping this predicate named is important for producers in later lanes: a
field-level divisor or chart witness is not a substitute for this arbitrary-affine-pullback
contract. -/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_iff {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    (lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T ↔
      ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam)) := by
  rfl

/-- Constructor for the exact lambda-tied arbitrary-affine-pullback presentation contract. -/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
        (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
        Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T :=
  (mem_picRankOneOpen_iff pi lam).mpr h

/-- Constructor using the named arbitrary-affine producer predicate. -/
theorem mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentationCondition
    {T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ}
    {lam : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).obj T}
    (h : PicRankOneOpen.LocalPresentationCondition pi lam) :
    lam ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj T := by
  exact mem_picRankOneOpen_of_localPresentations pi h

/-- The inclusion of the public rank-one locus into its degree-genus ambient functor. -/
def picRankOneOpenIncl :
    (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ) :=
  (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι

/-- The same inclusion after the slice-to-big-site `Σ` extension.

`IsOpenImmersion.presheaf` is a property of presheaves on schemes.  The rank-one functor is
defined on the slice over `Spec k`, so the `Σ` extension is the category-correct carrier for the
relative-open gate below. -/
def picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl :
    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
  Over.sigmaExtensionNat (PicRankOneOpen pi).ι

/-- Relative openness of the public locus, in Mathlib's presheaf sense.

This is a named acceptance gate rather than an unproved global assertion.  A future geometric
producer discharges it by supplying the represented open pullbacks; no arbitrary `Subfunctor` is
silently treated as an open subscheme. -/
def PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen : Prop :=
  IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi)

/-! ## The explicit fibre producer contract -/

/-- A fibre of the rank-one locus over one test class, presented by an open of that test.

The `exists_factor` field is tied to the displayed class `g` and to an arbitrary source value `v`.
It is the family-level content needed for relative representability; the open immersion itself
supplies uniqueness of the factor.  Thus this structure cannot be inhabited by an unrelated open
or by a fieldwise dimension statement. -/
structure PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented
    {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))) where
  W : X.Opens
  fst : yoneda.obj (W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
    Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor
  sq : fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g
  exists_factor : ∀ (S : Scheme.{u})
    (v : (Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor).obj (Opposite.op S))
    (w : S ⟶ X),
    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (Opposite.op S) v =
      g.app (Opposite.op S) w →
    ∃ u : S ⟶ (W : Scheme.{u}),
      fst.app (Opposite.op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ W.ι = w

namespace PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶
  Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ))}

/-- The fibre square supplied by `FibrePresented` is a pullback of presheaves. -/
theorem isPullback (D : PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g) :
    IsPullback D.fst (yoneda.map D.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g := by
  refine IsPullback.of_forall_isPullback_app fun S => ?_
  rw [Types.isPullback_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact congrArg (fun φ : yoneda.obj (D.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶
      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) =>
      φ.app S) D.sq
  · rintro u₁ u₂ ⟨-, h₂⟩
    exact (cancel_mono D.W.ι).mp h₂
  · intro v w hvw
    obtain ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩ := D.exists_factor S.unop v w hvw
    exact ⟨u, hu₁, hu₂⟩

end PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented

/-!
# The canonical rank-one divisor, Noetherian-free

`existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_mem` removes the Noetherian hypothesis from the canonical
rank-one divisor: over any affine test `A` whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus there
is a unique widened locally certified divisor class of degree `genus C` with Abel value the
input class — with no Noetherian hypothesis on any presentation carrier.  The price is the
structural hypothesis `hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.hom` tying the finite chart to the
curve, which feeds the finite-stage rigid engine.

Membership tested at the identity yields a presentation `P` of the input class on an étale
carrier `B := P.cover.Carrier`, arbitrary and in general not Noetherian.  The Noetherian
input of the glued-divisor keystone is manufactured by descent:

* the presented datum descends to a finitely generated — hence Noetherian — stage `A₀` with
  pair-`H¹` vanishing at the stage itself (`exists_fg_subalgebra_baseChange_eq` +
  `exists_fg_pairH1_vanishing_stage`);
* stage `H⁰` is finite projective (`datumRigidEngine`), so its `rankAtStalk` is locally
  constant; the rank-one level set of the stage is clopen, contains the image of
  `Spec B → Spec A₀` (rank one over `B` by the presentation), and that image is dense
  because `A₀ ⊆ B` is injective — hence the stage rank is one at every prime;
* rank one at a stage prime gives `h⁰ = 1` on the residue fibre, and the χ-formula
  `h⁰ = deg + (1 − genus)` (`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi`), solved backwards, pins
  the fibre degree of the stage class at `genus C`; the degree law extends to every field
  point of the stage through the kernel-prime residue embedding
  (`Ideal.ResidueField.liftₐ` + `classDeg_cechPicMap_baseFieldTransition`);
* the keystone `exists_glued_divFamZarAff_of_admissible_fibre` now fires at the Noetherian
  stage; the resulting family pushes up to `B`, its Abel value is the restricted input
  class, and `existsUnique_abel_divFamZarAff_of_etale_witness` with the discharged
  uniqueness interface descends it uniquely to `A`.

The unique class is extracted as `canonicalRankOneDivisorOfMem`, with its Abel equation
and uniqueness accessors.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
  Opposite TopologicalSpace
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open AlgebraicJacobian

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]

noncomputable local instance freeCanonicalOverCleft :
    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

/- Re-key the canonical field base-change package for the degree computations (the standing
pattern of the degree-stack files). -/
noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) freeCanonicalDegreeOver
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
  instOverBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance freeCanonicalDegreeSmooth
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance freeCanonicalDegreeIntegral
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance freeCanonicalDegreeQuasiCompact
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance freeCanonicalDegreeFiniteH0
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L

noncomputable local instance freeCanonicalDegreeFiniteH1
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L

/-! ## Reverse Riemann–Roch at a stage prime -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000 in
-- The presentation bridge and the fibre H⁰ equivalences elaborate large sheaf terms.
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
/-- **Reverse Riemann–Roch at a residue fibre**: for a datum over a Noetherian stage with
vanishing pair-`H¹` and finite projective `H⁰`, stalk rank one at a prime forces the fibre
degree of the datum class at that prime's residue field to be `genus C`.  This inverts the
Σ-RANK1 computation `rankAtStalk_hModule_zero_eq_one`: there the degree pins the rank; here
`h⁰ = 1` is read off the rank, and the χ-formula `h⁰ = deg + (1 − genus)`
(`h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi` through the presentation bridge) is solved for the
degree. -/
private theorem stage_classDeg_residueField
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C R pi)
    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
    [Module.Finite R (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)]
    [Module.Projective R (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)]
    (p : PrimeSpectrum R)
    (hrank : Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p = 1) :
    classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R p.asIdeal.ResidueField) D.cechPicClass)
      = (genus C : ℤ) := by
  rw [← D.cechPicClass_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField]
  -- the fibre global-section count is one, inverting the Σ-RANK1 calc
  have hfibre : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf = 1 := by
    have hcalc : Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p
        = Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf := by
      calc Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) p
          = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
              (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[R] (Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)) :=
            Module.rankAtStalk_eq p
        _ = Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
              (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 0) :=
            (D.datumH0BaseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1).finrank_eq
        _ = Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf := rfl
    rw [← hcalc, hrank]
  -- the χ-formula through the presentation bridge, solved backwards for the degree
  have hsub : Subsingleton
      (Sheaf.HModule (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf 1) :=
    D.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField hH1
  set P : (relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).MeromorphicPresentation :=
    Scheme.MeromorphicPresentation.ofCocycle
      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pointedCover
      (gluedSubordCocycle (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).isGluingCocycle
        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pointedCover
        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).pieceIndex
        fun _ => le_rfl) with hP
  have hsubP : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (P.gluedSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) 1) :=
    (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv
      (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso
        (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
      1).toEquiv.subsingleton_congr.mp hsub
  have h0eq : Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf
      = Sheaf.h0 (P.gluedSheaf p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
    Sheaf.h0_congr (BasicOpenCocycleDatum.presentationSheafIso
      (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField))
  have hformula := h0_gluedSheaf_eq_classDeg_add_chi p.asIdeal.ResidueField P hsubP
  have hPclass : P.picClass = (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass := rfl
  have hchi : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C p.asIdeal.ResidueField).moduleKSheaf
      p.asIdeal.ResidueField) = 1 - (genus C : ℤ) :=
    chi_relCurve (chi_moduleKSheaf C) p.asIdeal.ResidueField
  have h1 : ((Sheaf.h0 (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).sheaf : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = classDeg p.asIdeal.ResidueField
          (D.baseChange p.asIdeal.ResidueField).cechPicClass
        + (1 - (genus C : ℤ)) := by
    rw [h0eq, hformula, hPclass, hchi]
  rw [hfibre] at h1
  push_cast at h1
  linarith

   110	/--
   111	The explicit data needed to assemble one arbitrary-scheme rank-one fibre.
   112	
   113	`restrictedValue` is the restriction of the displayed ambient family to `W`, and
   114	`nativePresentation` quantifies over every affine pullback of that value.  The parameter `E` is
   115	the common evaluation-divisor classifier on the rank-one locus, with its Abel compatibility
   116	kept explicit.  Divisor representability is deliberately not a field of this structure: it is
   117	supplied separately as a pullback square to the assembly theorem.
   118	
   119	In particular, no field-fibre dimension witness, unrelated line bundle, or pre-existing
   120	`PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented` is accepted by this contract.  Conversely, this structure is not
   121	itself a producer: an inhabitant must still supply the arbitrary-affine native presentations.
   122	-/
   123	structure PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput
   124	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   125	    {X : Scheme.{u}}
   126	    (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)) where
   127	  W : X.Opens
   128	  restrictedValue : rankOneAmbient (C := C).obj (op (W : Scheme.{u}))
   129	  restrictedValue_eq :
   130	    restrictedValue =
   131	      (yoneda.map W.ι ≫ g).app (op (W : Scheme.{u})) (𝟙 (W : Scheme.{u}))
   132	  /-- The tied native presentation on every affine pullback of the restricted family value. -/
   133	  nativePresentation :
   134	    ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
   135	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ Over.mk restrictedValue.1),
   136	      Nonempty (PicRankOneNativePresentation pi
   137	        ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op restrictedValue.2))

   139	namespace PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput

   141	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
   142	variable {g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)}
   143	variable {E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi}
   144	
   145	/-- The public-locus element carried by the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   146	noncomputable def locusValue (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   147	    (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op (F.W : Scheme.{u})) :=
   148	  ⟨F.restrictedValue.1, ⟨F.restrictedValue.2,
   149	    mem_picRankOneOpen_of_nativePresentations pi
   150	      (fun A _ _ t => F.nativePresentation A t)⟩⟩
   151	
   152	/-- The map into the public locus is obtained from its universal element by Yoneda. -/
   153	noncomputable def fst (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   154	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   155	  yonedaEquiv.symm F.locusValue
   156	
   157	/-- The canonical evaluation divisor of the restricted family value over `W`. -/
   158	noncomputable def evaluationDivisor
   159	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   160	    yoneda.obj (F.W : Scheme.{u}) ⟶ rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   161	  F.fst ≫ E.divisor
   162	
   163	/-- The factorisation clause required by `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`, exposed as the target
   164	of the represented evaluation-divisor argument below. -/
   165	def FibreFactorizationClause
   166	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   167	  ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (v : (rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)).obj (op S)) (w : S ⟶ X),
   168	    (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v =
   169	      g.app (op S) w →
   170	    ∃ u : S ⟶ (F.W : Scheme.{u}),
   171	      F.fst.app (op S) u = v ∧ u ≫ F.W.ι = w
   172	
   173	lemma fst_comp_incl (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   174	    F.fst ≫ picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi = yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   175	  apply yonedaEquiv.injective
   176	  rw [yonedaEquiv_comp, fst, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, yonedaEquiv_apply,
   177	    ← F.restrictedValue_eq]
   178	  dsimp [locusValue, picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl,
   179	    CategoryTheory.Over.sigmaExtensionNat]
   180	  rfl
   181	
   182	/-- The family evaluation divisor has the displayed family as its Abel class. -/
   183	lemma evaluationDivisor_abel
   184	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) :
   185	    F.evaluationDivisor ≫ rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi =
   186	      yoneda.map F.W.ι ≫ g := by
   187	  rw [evaluationDivisor, Category.assoc, E.divisor_toAmbient]
   188	  exact F.fst_comp_incl

   190	/-! ## The represented rank-one-divisor fibre square -/
   191	
   192	/-- The open `W` represents the pullback of the restricted divisor-class map along the displayed
   193	family, with its top map fixed by the canonical evaluation divisor.  This is stronger than the
   194	factorisation clause for the public rank-one locus: it is a categorical pullback against the
   195	entire restricted rank-one divisor presheaf. -/
   196	def EvaluationDivisorPullback
   197	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g) : Prop :=
   198	  IsPullback
   199	    F.evaluationDivisor
   200	    (yoneda.map F.W.ι)
   201	    (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi)
   202	    g
   203	
   204	/-- The represented evaluation-divisor square produces the public-locus factorisation on every
   205	test scheme. -/
   206	lemma fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   207	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   208	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   209	    F.FibreFactorizationClause := by
   210	  intro S v w hvw
   211	  have hS := (IsPullback.iff_app.mp hpb) (op S)
   212	  rw [Types.isPullback_iff] at hS
   213	  have hcompat :
   214	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   215	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   216	        g.app (op S) w := by
   217	    have h := congrArg
   218	      (fun q => q.app (op S) v) E.divisor_toAmbient
   219	    change
   220	      (rankOneDivisorToAmbient pi).app (op S)
   221	          (E.divisor.app (op S) v) =
   222	        (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi).app (op S) v at h
   223	    rw [h]
   224	    exact hvw
   225	  obtain ⟨u, huDivisor, huW⟩ :=
   226	    hS.2.2 (E.divisor.app (op S) v) w hcompat
   227	  change E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u) =
   228	    E.divisor.app (op S) v at huDivisor
   229	  change u ≫ F.W.ι = w at huW
   230	  refine ⟨u, ?_, huW⟩
   231	  calc
   232	    F.fst.app (op S) u =
   233	        (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S)
   234	          (E.divisor.app (op S) (F.fst.app (op S) u)) :=
   235	      (E.divisor_abel_app pi S (F.fst.app (op S) u)).symm
   236	    _ = (rankOneAbelSigma pi).app (op S) (E.divisor.app (op S) v) :=
   237	      congrArg _ huDivisor
   238	    _ = v := E.divisor_abel_app pi S v
   239	
   240	/-! ## Assembly of the stronger fibre datum -/
   241	
   242	/-- Assemble the public fibre presentation from the represented canonical evaluation-divisor
   243	square.  Its `exists_factor` field is derived from the pullback universal property. -/
   244	noncomputable def toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback
   245	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   246	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   247	    PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented pi g where
   248	  W := F.W
   249	  fst := F.fst
   250	  sq := F.fst_comp_incl
   251	  exists_factor := by
   252	    simpa only [FibreFactorizationClause] using
   253	      F.fibreFactorizationClause_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb
   254	
   255	@[simp]
   256	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_W
   257	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   258	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   259	    (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).W = F.W :=
   260	  rfl
   261	
   262	lemma toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback_isPullback
   263	    (F : PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   264	    (hpb : F.EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   265	    IsPullback F.fst (yoneda.map F.W.ι) (picRankOneOpenSigmaIncl pi) g :=
   266	  (F.toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi hpb).isPullback
   267	
   268	/-! ## Immediate openness consumer -/
   269	
   270	theorem picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_evaluationDivisorPullbackFamilies
   271	    (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi)
   272	    (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   273	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   274	      PicRankOneFibrePresentationInput pi E g)
   275	    (hpb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
   276	      (g : yoneda.obj X ⟶ rankOneAmbient (C := C)),
   277	      (D X g).EvaluationDivisorPullback) :
   278	    PicRankOneOpen.IsOpen pi := by
   279	  apply picRankOneOpen_isOpen_of_fibrePresented pi
   280	  intro X g
   281	  exact (D X g).toFibrePresented_of_evaluationDivisorPullback pi (hpb X g)
   282

   144	/-- **The Σ-extension of the degree-zero Picard functor, bundled as a sheaf on the

   151	/-! ## The DAT-glue seam -/
   152	
   153	/-- **The DAT-glue statement (worksheet §4, DAT-glue row)**: a chart family of
   154	relatively representable open immersions into the Σ-extension sheaf (DAT-C's
   155	certificates) that is jointly Zariski-locally surjective (DAT-B's coverage) induces —
   156	through mathlib's 01JJ engine and the stage-2 Σ-descent — a representation of the
   157	type-valued degree-zero Picard functor by the glued scheme placed over the
   158	Σ-component of the universal element.  The represented object's `.left` is
   159	`(Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued` and its `.hom` is the universal
   160	element's Σ-component, both definitionally. -/
   161	noncomputable def pic0RepresentableByOfCharts
   162	    {ι : Type u} {X : ι → Scheme.{u}}
   163	    (f : ∀ i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ (pic0SigmaSheaf C).1)
   164	    (hf : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i))
   165	    [Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective Scheme.zariskiTopology (Sigma.desc f)] :
   166	    (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy
   167	      (Over.mk ((Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).homEquiv
   168	        (𝟙 (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.glueData hf).glued)).1) :=
   169	  (Scheme.LocalRepresentability.representableBy hf).overSlice
   170

    10	/-!
    11	# Big-etale descent for the Pic0 Sigma functor
    12	
    13	The big etale topology agrees with the quasi-compact topology generated by etale
    14	morphisms.  Its sheaf condition therefore reduces to Zariski descent and singleton
    15	surjective etale maps between affine schemes.  The latter is supplied by the affine
    16	Pic0 descent theorem.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    24	open scoped TensorProduct

    29	
    30	/-- The ordinary and quasi-compact presentations generate the same big etale topology. -/
    31	theorem Scheme.etaleTopology_eq_propQCTopology :
    32	    Scheme.etaleTopology.{u} = Scheme.propQCTopology (@Etale) := by
    33	  apply le_antisymm
    34	  · apply Precoverage.toGrothendieck_mono
    35	    rw [Scheme.propQCPrecoverage, le_inf_iff]
    36	    exact ⟨Scheme.precoverage_le_qcPrecoverage_of_isOpenMap
    37	      (fun _ _ f _ => f.isOpenMap), le_rfl⟩
    38	  · exact Precoverage.toGrothendieck_mono
    39	      Scheme.propQCPrecoverage_le_precoverage
    40	
    41	private theorem etaleCover_doubleProjection_comp_base
    42	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    43	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    44	    let d₀ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
    45	      Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)
    46	    let d₁ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
    47	      Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)
    48	    let g : Spec (.of E.Carrier) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
    49	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))
    50	    d₀.left ≫ g = d₁.left ≫ g := by
    51	  dsimp only
    52	  let f : A →ₐ[k] E.Carrier :=
    53	    (Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k
    54	  let d : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ overSpec k A := Over.overSpecMap f
    55	  let d₀ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
    56	    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)
    57	  let d₁ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
    58	    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)
    59	  have hcomp :
    60	      (doubleInl (k := k) E).comp f =
    61	        (doubleInr (k := k) E).comp f := by
    62	    ext r
    63	    simp [f, doubleInl, doubleInr]
    64	  have hover : d₀ ≫ d = d₁ ≫ d := by
    65	    dsimp only [d₀, d₁, d]
    66	    rw [← Over.overSpecMap_comp, ← Over.overSpecMap_comp, hcomp]
    67	  have hleft := congrArg Over.Hom.left hover
    68	  have hf : f.toRingHom = algebraMap A E.Carrier := rfl
    69	  simpa only [Over.comp_left, d₀, d₁, d, Over.overSpecMap_left, hf,
    70	    overSpec_left] using hleft
    71	
    72	set_option maxHeartbeats 400000 in
    73	/-- The Pic0 Sigma functor satisfies descent for the singleton scheme cover attached to a
    74	presented etale algebra cover. -/
    75	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleCover
    76	    {k A : Type u} [Field k] [CommRing A]
    77	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
    78	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    79	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
    80	    (E : Algebra.EtaleCover A) :
    81	    Presieve.IsSheafFor (pic0SigmaFunctor C)
    82	      (.singleton (Spec.map
    83	        (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)))) := by
    84	  rw [Presieve.isSheafFor_singleton]
    85	  rintro ⟨b, x⟩ hx
    86	  let g : Spec (.of E.Carrier) ⟶ Spec (.of A) :=
    87	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier))
    88	  letI : Surjective g :=
    89	    ⟨E.comap_surjective⟩
    90	  haveI : Etale g := by
    91	    dsimp [g]
    92	    rw [HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)]
    93	    exact RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mpr inferInstance
    94	  have hbase : ∀ {Z : Scheme.{u}} (p₁ p₂ : Z ⟶ Spec (.of E.Carrier)),
    95	      p₁ ≫ g = p₂ ≫ g → p₁ ≫ b = p₂ ≫ b := by
    96	    intro Z p₁ p₂ hp
    97	    exact congrArg Sigma.fst (hx p₁ p₂ hp)
    98	  let a : Spec (.of A) ⟶ Spec (.of k) :=
    99	    EffectiveEpi.desc g b hbase
   100	  have ha : g ≫ a = b := EffectiveEpi.fac g b hbase
   101	  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := Spec.map_surjective a
   102	  algebraize [φ.hom]
   103	  have haφ : g ≫ Spec.map φ = b := by
   104	    rw [hφ]
   105	    exact ha
   106	  have hE : (overSpec k E.Carrier).hom = b := by
   107	    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k E.Carrier)) = b
   108	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k A E.Carrier]
   109	    change Spec.map (φ ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A E.Carrier)) = b
   110	    rw [Spec.map_comp]
   111	    exact haφ
   112	  let eIso : overSpec k E.Carrier ≅ Over.mk b :=
   113	    Over.isoMk (Iso.refl _) hE.symm
   114	  let e : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ Over.mk b := eIso.hom
   115	  let xE : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k E.Carrier) := pic0Map C e x
   116	  let d₀ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
   117	    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInl (k := k) E)
   118	  let d₁ : overSpec k (E.Carrier ⊗[A] E.Carrier) ⟶ overSpec k E.Carrier :=
   119	    Over.overSpecMap (doubleInr (k := k) E)
   120	  have hlegs : d₀.left ≫ g = d₁.left ≫ g := by
   121	    exact etaleCover_doubleProjection_comp_base E
   122	  have hd₀e : (d₀ ≫ e).left = d₀.left := by
   123	    simp only [Over.comp_left, e, eIso, Over.isoMk_hom_left, Iso.refl_hom]
   124	    exact Category.comp_id _
   125	  have hd₁e : (d₁ ≫ e).left = d₁.left := by
   126	    simp only [Over.comp_left, e, eIso, Over.isoMk_hom_left, Iso.refl_hom]
   127	    exact Category.comp_id _
   128	  have hSigma :
   129	      (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map (d₀ ≫ e).left.op ⟨b, x⟩ =
   130	        (pic0SigmaFunctor C).map (d₁ ≫ e).left.op ⟨b, x⟩ := by
   131	    rw [hd₀e, hd₁e]
   132	    exact hx d₀.left d₁.left hlegs
   133	  have hFib := Over.map_eq_of_sigmaExtension_map_eq
   134	    (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) (d₀ ≫ e) (d₁ ≫ e) hSigma
   135	  have hdouble :
   136	      pic0Map C d₀ xE = pic0Map C d₁ xE := by
   137	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d₀.op
   138	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op x) =
   139	      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d₁.op
   140	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op x)
   141	    rw [← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply, ← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply]
   142	    exact hFib
   143	  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzu⟩ :=
   144	    pic0Subgroup_existsUnique_of_etaleCover C E xE hdouble
   145	  let d : overSpec k E.Carrier ⟶ overSpec k A :=
   146	    Over.overSpecMap ((Algebra.ofId A E.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   147	  let q : Over.mk b ⟶ overSpec k A := Over.homMk g haφ
   148	  have heq : e ≫ q = d := by
   149	    apply Over.OverMorphism.ext
   150	    rfl
   151	  have hrestrict (t : pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k A)) :
   152	      pic0Map C e (pic0Map C q t) = pic0Map C d t := by
   153	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op
   154	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map q.op t) =
   155	      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map d.op t
   156	    rw [← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, heq]
   157	  have hq : pic0Map C q z = x := by
   158	    apply (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso
   159	      ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op)).1
   160	    change (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op
   161	        ((pic0TypeFunctor C).map q.op z) =
   162	      (pic0TypeFunctor C).map e.op x
   163	    rw [← FunctorToTypes.map_comp_apply, ← op_comp, heq]
   164	    change pic0Map C d z = xE
   165	    exact hz
   166	  refine ⟨⟨Spec.map φ, z⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
   167	  · refine (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff
   168	      (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) g haφ z x).mpr ?_
   169	    rw [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply]
   170	    exact hq
   171	  · rintro ⟨a', z'⟩ hz'
   172	    have ha' : a' = Spec.map φ := by
   173	      exact (EffectiveEpi.uniq g b hbase a'
   174	        (congrArg Sigma.fst hz')).trans hφ.symm
   175	    subst a'
   176	    change pic0Subgroup C (overSpec k A) at z'
   177	    refine congrArg (Sigma.mk (Spec.map φ)) (hzu z' ?_)
   178	    have hq' : pic0Map C q z' = x := by
   179	      have hmem := (Over.sigmaExtension_map_mk_eq_iff
   180	        (F := pic0TypeFunctor C) g haφ z' x).mp hz'
   181	      rw [pic0TypeFunctor_map_apply] at hmem
   182	      exact hmem
   183	    calc
   184	      pic0Map C d z' = pic0Map C e (pic0Map C q z') := (hrestrict z').symm
   185	      _ = pic0Map C e x := congrArg (pic0Map C e) hq'
   186	      _ = xE := rfl
   187	
   188	/-- Singleton descent for the Pic0 Sigma functor along an arbitrary surjective etale map
   189	between affine schemes.  The base-field algebra structures and a small presented cover are
   190	chosen internally. -/
   191	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleSingleton
   192	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   193	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
   194	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   195	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]
   196	    {R S : CommRingCat.{u}} (f : R ⟶ S)
   197	    (hf : Etale (Spec.map f)) (hs : Surjective (Spec.map f)) :
   198	    Presieve.IsSheafFor (pic0SigmaFunctor C)
   199	      (.singleton (Spec.map f)) := by
   200	  algebraize [f.hom]
   201	  haveI : Algebra.Etale R S :=
   202	    RingHom.etale_algebraMap.mp
   203	      ((HasRingHomProperty.Spec_iff (P := @Etale)).mp hf)
   204	  have hcomap :
   205	      Function.Surjective (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap R S)) := by
   206	    exact (surjective_iff (Spec.map f)).mp hs
   207	  let E : Algebra.EtaleCover R := Algebra.EtaleCover.of S hcomap
   208	  let e : Spec S ≅ Spec (.of E.Carrier) :=
   209	    Scheme.Spec.mapIso
   210	      (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).toRingEquiv.toCommRingCatIso.op
   211	  have he : e.hom ≫
   212	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R E.Carrier)) =
   213	      Spec.map f := by
   214	    change Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   215	        (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).toRingEquiv.toRingHom) ≫
   216	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
   217	        (algebraMap R (Algebra.EtaleCover.of S hcomap).Carrier)) =
   218	      Spec.map f
   219	    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
   220	    congr 1
   221	    ext r
   222	    exact (Algebra.EtaleCover.ofEquiv S hcomap).commutes r
   223	  exact (Presieve.isSheafFor_singleton_iff_of_iso
   224	    (Spec.map f)
   225	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R E.Carrier))) e he).mpr
   226	      (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleCover C E)
   227	
   228	/-- The raw Pic0 Sigma functor is a sheaf for the big etale topology. -/
   229	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale
   230	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   231	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
   232	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   233	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] :
   234	    Presieve.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (pic0SigmaFunctor C) := by
   235	  rw [Scheme.etaleTopology_eq_propQCTopology,
   236	    isSheaf_type_propQCTopology_iff]
   237	  exact ⟨pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf C,
   238	    fun f hf hs =>
   239	      pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheafFor_etaleSingleton C f hf hs⟩
   240	
   241	/-- The categorical sheaf certificate associated to raw big-etale Pic0 Sigma descent. -/
   242	theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_presheafIsSheaf_etale
   243	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   244	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
   245	    [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   246	    [GeometricallyReduced C.hom] :
   247	    Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology (pic0SigmaFunctor C) :=
   248	  (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr
   249	    (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale C)
   250	
   251	end
   252	
   253	end AlgebraicGeometry

     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RankOneUniquenessDischarge
     8	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0RigidityAffineReduction
     9	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyAffClassDegree
    10	
    11	/-!
    12	# The Abel inverse of the canonical evaluation divisor, unconditionally
    13	
    14	`rankOneDivisorUniqueness` (`Pic0RankOneUniquenessDischarge.lean`) settles, over every affine
    15	test whose plus class lies in the rank-one locus, that at most one widened locally certified
    16	divisor class of degree `genus C` has a prescribed Abel value.  This file upgrades that affine
    17	statement into the second inverse law of the rank-one Abel/evaluation pair on the big site: every
    18	`E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi` automatically satisfies `E.AbelInverse`, so its
    19	`evaluationIso` is available with no extra hypothesis.
    20	
    21	The upgrade is genuinely local-to-global on the base, and it reuses only landed material:
    22	
    23	* **The vehicle collapse along an affine open** (`divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine`):
    24	  restricting a widened vehicle section along `Over.fromSpecAffine T U` and collapsing through the
    25	  affine comparison recovers the section's value at the affine open `U`.  This is the `mapVal`
    26	  no-gluing computation followed by the `Spec`-`Γ` bookkeeping identity
    27	  `fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom`.
    28	* **Arbitrary-test uniqueness** (`divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne`): two widened vehicle sections over
    29	  an arbitrary test whose Abel values agree, one of whose Abel classes lies in the rank-one locus,
    30	  are equal.  Two sections of the widened vehicle agree iff they agree on affine opens
    31	  (`divFamZarAff.ext`); on each affine open the pulled-back rank-one class (via
    32	  `picRankOneOpen_map_mem` along `Over.fromSpecAffine T U`) feeds the affine
    33	  `rankOneDivisorUniqueness`, with the affine Abel value identified through
    34	  `picEtMap_abelDivAff'`, `picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff'`, and the vehicle collapse above.
    35	* **Monomorphy of the restricted Abel map** (`rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective`): arbitrary-test
    36	  uniqueness gives injectivity of the represented Abel map on every slice object, and the
    37	  `Σ`-extension preserves it componentwise.
    38	
    39	Given a right inverse (`E.divisor_abel`) and injectivity of `rankOneAbelSigma pi`, the standard
    40	cancellation yields the left inverse `E.AbelInverse`, hence the packaged `rankOneAbelIso`.
    41	-/
    42	
    43	set_option autoImplicit false
    44	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    45	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
    46	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
    47	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    48	
    49	universe u
    50	
    51	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite
    52	
    53	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    54	
    55	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    56	
    57	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    58	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    59	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    60	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    61	
    62	noncomputable section
    63	
    64	/-! ## The vehicle collapse along an affine open -/
    65	
    66	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
    67	/-- Restricting a widened vehicle section along the affine-open test object `Over.fromSpecAffine
    68	T U` and collapsing through the affine comparison recovers the section's value at `U`.  The
    69	`mapVal` no-gluing computation and the `Spec`-`Γ` bookkeeping identity
    70	`fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom`. -/
    71	theorem divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine (n : ℕ) (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    72	    (s : divFamZarAff C n T) (U : T.left.affineOpens) :
    73	    divFamZarAffAffineEquiv C n Γ(T.left, U.1)
    74	        (divFamZarAff.map C n (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s)
    75	      = s.1 U := by
    76	  rw [divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_apply, divFamZarAff.map_val,
    77	    divFamZarAff.mapVal_eq_mapAlgHom C n (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) s
    78	      (top_le_preimage_fromSpecAffine T U),
    79	    ← DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_comp, fromSpecAffine_ΓTop_comp_appLEAlgHom T U,
    80	    DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom_id]
    81	
    82	/-! ## Arbitrary-test uniqueness of the widened Abel map on the rank-one locus -/
    83	
    84	/-- **Arbitrary-test rank-one uniqueness**: two widened vehicle sections over an arbitrary test
    85	`T` whose widened Abel values agree, one of whose Abel classes lies in the rank-one locus, are
    86	equal.  The vehicle is separated by affine opens, and on each affine open the pulled-back rank-one
    87	class feeds the affine `rankOneDivisorUniqueness`. -/
    88	theorem divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne (T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    89	    (s₁ s₂ : divFamZarAff C (genus C) T)
    90	    (hs₁ : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁ ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op T))
    91	    (habel : abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₁ = abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₂) :
    92	    s₁ = s₂ := by
    93	  refine divFamZarAff.ext fun U => ?_
    94	  -- pull the rank-one class back along the affine-open test object
    95	  have hmem : (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
    96	        ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)
    97	      ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op (overSpec k Γ(T.left, U.1))) :=
    98	    picRankOneOpen_map_mem pi (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op hs₁
    99	  -- the pulled-back Abel value is the affine Abel value of `s₁.1 U`
   100	  have hval : abelDivAffPlus C Γ(T.left, U.1) (s₁.1 U)
   101	      = picEtAffineEquiv C Γ(T.left, U.1)
   102	          ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
   103	            ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)).1 := by
   104	    have h1 : ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map (Over.fromSpecAffine T U).op
   105	          ((abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op T) s₁)).1
   106	        = picEtMap C (Over.fromSpecAffine T U) (abelDivAff' C (genus C) T s₁) := rfl
   107	    rw [h1, picEtMap_abelDivAff', picEtAffineEquiv_abelDivAff',
   108	      divFamZarAffAffineEquiv_map_fromSpecAffine]
   109	  -- the two affine Abel values agree, from equality of the vehicle Abel values
   110	  have hU := congrArg (fun w : picEt C T => w.1 U) habel
   111	  rw [abelDivAff'_val, abelDivAff'_val] at hU
   112	  exact rankOneDivisorUniqueness pi Γ(T.left, U.1) _ hmem (s₁.1 U) (s₂.1 U) hval
   113	    (hU.symm.trans hval)
   114	
   115	/-! ## Monomorphy of the restricted Abel map -/
   116	
   117	/-- The represented Abel map is injective on every slice object: this is arbitrary-test
   118	uniqueness read through the subfunctor preimage plumbing. -/
   119	theorem rankOneAbelRepresented_app_injective (Z : Over (Spec (.of k))) :
   120	    Function.Injective ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op Z)) := by
   121	  intro x y h
   122	  have hinj : Function.Injective
   123	      ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z)) :=
   124	    Function.LeftInverse.injective fun a =>
   125	      (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom_inv_id_app_apply (op Z) a
   126	  set sx := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) x.val with hsx
   127	  set sy := (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) y.val with hsy
   128	  -- the underlying widened Abel values agree
   129	  have happ : ∀ w : (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor.obj (op Z),
   130	      ((rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op Z) w).val
   131	        = (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z)
   132	            ((divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom.app (op Z) w.val) := fun _ => rfl
   133	  have hval : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sx
   134	      = (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sy := by
   135	    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
   136	    rwa [happ, happ] at this
   137	  have habel : abelDivAff' C (genus C) Z sx = abelDivAff' C (genus C) Z sy := by
   138	    have := congrArg Subtype.val hval
   139	    rwa [abelDivAffTrans_app_coe, abelDivAffTrans_app_coe] at this
   140	  -- membership of the rank-one class of `sx`
   141	  have hmem : (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C)).app (op Z) sx
   142	      ∈ (PicRankOneOpen pi).obj (op Z) := x.property
   143	  -- arbitrary-test uniqueness forces the vehicle sections to agree
   144	  have hsxy : sx = sy := divFamZarAff_eq_of_rankOne pi Z sx sy hmem habel
   145	  exact Subtype.ext (hinj (hsx ▸ hsy ▸ hsxy))
   146	
   147	/-- Componentwise injectivity of the restricted represented Abel map on the big site: the
   148	`Σ`-extension preserves the slicewise injectivity of `rankOneAbelRepresented`. -/
   149	theorem rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective (Y : Schemeᵒᵖ) :
   150	    Function.Injective ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y) := by
   151	  rintro ⟨a, ξ⟩ ⟨b, η⟩ h
   152	  have ha : (⟨a, (rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op (Over.mk a)) ξ⟩ :
   153	        Σ c : Y.unop ⟶ Spec (.of k),
   154	          (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor.obj (op (Over.mk c)))
   155	      = ⟨b, (rankOneAbelRepresented pi).app (op (Over.mk b)) η⟩ := h
   156	  obtain ⟨rfl, h2⟩ := Sigma.mk.inj_iff.mp ha
   157	  simp only [heq_eq_eq] at h2
   158	  obtain rfl := rankOneAbelRepresented_app_injective pi (Over.mk a) h2
   159	  rfl

   162	
   163	namespace PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData
   164	
   165	/-- **The Abel inverse law holds automatically**: every canonical evaluation-divisor classifier
   166	of the rank-one locus is a two-sided inverse of the restricted Abel map.  From the right inverse
   167	`E.divisor_abel` and injectivity of `rankOneAbelSigma pi`, the left inverse follows by
   168	cancellation. -/
   169	theorem abelInverse_of_uniqueness (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
   170	    E.AbelInverse := by
   171	  have h : rankOneAbelSigma pi ≫ E.divisor
   172	      = 𝟙 (rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi)) := by
   173	    ext Y d
   174	    change E.divisor.app Y ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y d) = d
   175	    apply rankOneAbelSigma_app_injective pi Y
   176	    exact E.divisor_abel_app pi Y.unop ((rankOneAbelSigma pi).app Y d)
   177	  exact h
   178	
   179	/-- The rank-one family isomorphism, with the Abel inverse discharged: the restricted Abel map
   180	and the canonical evaluation divisor are mutually inverse on the big site. -/
   181	noncomputable def rankOneAbelIso (E : PicRankOneEvaluationDivisorData pi) :
   182	    rankOneDivisorLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) ≅ rankOneLocus (C := C) (pi := pi) :=
   183	  E.evaluationIso pi (E.abelInverse_of_uniqueness pi)
   184

    10	/-!
    11	# Finite gluing of the rank-one evaluation divisor on a presentation carrier
    12	
    13	Over the Noetherian affine carrier of a tied rank-one presentation, the local evaluation
    14	divisors produced on a finite spanning family of principal opens are compatible on pairwise
    15	overlaps.  They therefore glue to an actual `DivFamZarAff` on the carrier.  Zariski separation
    16	of `PicEtAff` identifies the Abel value of the glue with the represented input class, and
    17	injectivity of the etale-plus unit identifies its relative Picard class with the presentation
    18	representative.  The chosen local sections retain their exact Cech-class and native evaluation
    19	identities.
    20	
    21	This is deliberately only a Noetherian, presentation-carrier result.  It does **not** descend
    22	the glued divisor through the etale cover to the original algebra `A`, does not prove
    23	independence of the chosen presentation, does not construct an arbitrary-scheme pullback
    24	square, and does not produce `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`.
    25	-/
    26

    50	/-- The finite principal-open evaluation divisors of a tied rank-one presentation glue on its
    51	Noetherian etale carrier.  The result records the global Abel and relative-Picard identities,
    52	while retaining the exact local Cech-class and evaluation identities of the chosen sections.
    53	
    54	The divisor `F0` lives over `P.cover.Carrier`; this theorem neither descends it to `A` nor
    55	constructs `PicRankOneOpen.FibrePresented`. -/
    56	theorem exists_glued_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    57	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
    58	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier] :
    59	    ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → P.cover.Carrier)
    60	      (y : Fin m → Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
    61	      (hy : ∀ (i : Fin m) (q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier),
    62	        f i ∉ q.asIdeal →
    63	          (y i ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
    64	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
    65	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
    66	      (F0 : DivFamZarAff C P.cover.Carrier (genus C)),
    67	      Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤ ∧
    68	        (∀ i : Fin m,
    69	          DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
    70	              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
    71	                (Localization.Away (f i))) F0 =
    72	            P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)) ∧
    73	        abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
    74	          PicEtAff.mapAlg C
    75	            ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
    76	            (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) ∧
    77	        relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass =
    78	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) ∧
    79	        (∀ i : Fin m,
    80	          (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
    81	              (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
    82	                (Localization.Away (f i))) F0).picClass =
    83	            (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away (f i))).cechPicClass) ∧
    84	        ∀ i : Fin m,
    85	          (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
    86	            ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    87	              (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
    88	            (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 (y i)) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 (y i) := by
    89	  classical
    90	  obtain ⟨m, f, hspan, hgood⟩ :=
    91	    P.exists_fin_rankOne_away_divisor_with_abel_evaluation
    92	  choose y hy habel hclass heval using hgood
    93	  let F : ∀ i : Fin m, DivFamZarAff C (Localization.Away (f i)) (genus C) :=
    94	    fun i => P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor (f i) (y i) (hy i)
    95	  have hcompat : ∀ i j : Fin m,
    96	      DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulLeft (k := k) f i j) (F i) =
    97	        DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom (DivFamZar.awayMulRight (k := k) f i j) (F j) := by
    98	    intro i j
    99	    exact P.baseOpenRankOneDivisor_awayMul_compat
   100	      (f i) (f j) (y i) (y j) (hy i) (hy j)
   101	  obtain ⟨F0, hF0⟩ :=
   102	    DivFamZarAff.exists_glue_of_awaySpan f hspan F hcompat
   103	  have habel0 : abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0 =
   104	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   105	        ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   106	        (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) := by
   107	    refine PicEtAff.eq_of_away_eq C
   108	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down)
   109	      (fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => Localization.Away (f l.down)) ?_ (fun l => ?_)
   110	    · rw [show (Set.range fun l : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => f l.down) = Set.range f from
   111	        ULift.down_surjective.range_comp f]
   112	      exact hspan
   113	    · let i := l.down
   114	      change PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   115	          (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   116	            (Localization.Away (f i)))
   117	          (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) = _
   118	      calc
   119	        PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   120	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   121	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   122	            (abelDivAffPlus C P.cover.Carrier F0) =
   123	            abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i))
   124	              (DivFamZarAff.mapAlgHom
   125	                (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   126	                  (Localization.Away (f i))) F0) :=
   127	          abelDivAffPlus_mapAlgHom
   128	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   129	              (Localization.Away (f i))) F0
   130	        _ = abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i)) (F i) :=
   131	          congrArg (abelDivAffPlus C (Localization.Away (f i))) (hF0 i)
   132	        _ = PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   133	            (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier
   134	              (Localization.Away (f i)))
   135	            (PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   136	              ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   137	              (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1)) := by
   138	          have hphi :
   139	              (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i))).restrictScalars k =
   140	                IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k P.cover.Carrier (Localization.Away (f i)) :=
   141	            AlgHom.ext (fun _ => rfl)
   142	          rw [← hphi]
   143	          simpa only [F] using habel i
   144	  have htarget :
   145	      PicEtAff.mapAlg C
   146	          ((Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k)
   147	          (picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1) =
   148	        PicEtAff.unit C P.cover.Carrier
   149	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   150	    rw [← P.represents, PicEtAff.mapAlg_mk_eq_unit_self]
   151	  have hrel : relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier) F0.picClass =
   152	      (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   153	    apply PicEtAff.unit_injective C P.cover.Carrier
   154	    rw [← htarget]
   155	    exact habel0
   156	  refine ⟨m, f, y, hy, F0, hspan, ?_, habel0, hrel, ?_, heval⟩
   157	  · intro i
   158	    simpa only [F] using hF0 i
   159	  · intro i
   160	    rw [hF0 i]
   161	    exact hclass i
   162
